subject.title: Plugin Hooks: Missing trace context for observability (messageId, runId in all hooks, parentSpanId)

question: What single additive Plugin SDK trace-correlation contract should own message, run, span, and requester/child run context across agent lifecycle, outbound message, and subagent hooks?
rationale: Current main has partial runId and trace-carrier plumbing, but choosing flat span aliases, outbound run propagation, and parent/child run fields is a public plugin API design decision that automation should not guess.

options.title: Define one additive contract
options.body: Approve a minimal shared field set and implement it consistently across lifecycle, message, and subagent hooks with docs and contract tests.

options.title: Split by narrower issues
options.body: Keep this issue as the umbrella while https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/80551 and https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/18571 land their slices independently.

options.title: Defer hook expansion
options.body: Leave current diagnostics and partial hook correlation as the supported surface for now, accepting that some third-party trace trees remain heuristic.

recommendation.title: Define one additive contract
recommendation.body: Approve a minimal shared field set and implement it consistently across lifecycle, message, and subagent hooks with docs and contract tests.

likelyOwner.reason: Their trace carrier and hook-correlation history is closest to the API contract this issue would extend.
